company.name: The Ticket Fairy
company.shortDescription: The Ticket Fairy is an event ticketing, marketing, management, and revenue acceleration platform.
company.description: The Ticket Fairy provides marketing and analytics solutions that help events to get relevant attendees and secure their ticket income. They specialize in social event marketing, ticketing, management, and empowering events and venues.

productsAndServices.description: A web-based event ticketing and management platform for creating, selling, and administering tickets for concerts, festivals, parties, conferences, and other live events.
productsAndServices.name: Ticket Fairy Platform

productsAndServices.description: A consumer-facing marketplace for discovering events, purchasing tickets, accessing digital tickets, and buying event add-ons such as VIP upgrades, merchandise, parking, and camping passes.
productsAndServices.name: Online Ticket Sales and Event Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A referral marketing service that gives ticket buyers unique sharing links and provides cash rebates when referred contacts purchase tickets.
productsAndServices.name: Referral Marketing and Rewards

productsAndServices.description: An integration service that enables organizers to sell Ticket Fairy tickets through their own websites using embeddable widgets, white-label checkout, and API access.
productsAndServices.name: White-Label Ticketing and Integrations

productsAndServices.description: An event financing service that provides qualified organizers with advance funding against projected ticket sales to help cover production costs before ticket sales begin.
productsAndServices.name: Ticket Fairy Capital

productsAndServices.description: A resale service that allows eligible ticket holders to resell tickets at face value and enables buyers to receive genuine tickets with updated attendee information.
productsAndServices.name: Secure Ticket Resale Marketplace

aiResearchSummary.text: The Ticket Fairy is researching metadata-based generation and management of event presentations. This involves selecting target audiences and programmatically generating multiple presentations and a presentation plan. The technology also includes programmatically executing these plans, aligning with their focus on event ticketing, marketing, and management. This research supports their platform's capabilities in enhancing event presentation and management processes.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,500,000, or 80.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,534,315 to $12,199,961, a 3.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 82 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (+9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Eventbrite, Ticket Tailor, Ticketmaster.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
